t: Someone uttered an expression above his position, then Amir al-Mu'minin, peace be upon him, said to him : You have started flying soon after growing feathers (shair) and commenced-grumbling before attaining youth (saqb). Al-Sayyid al-Radi says: Here "shakir" means the first feathers that grow on a bird before it is strong enough to fly. And saqb means the young camel who does not grumble unless it becomes major.
